 Follow Saturday's Premier League games live 
 Published 3 hours ago 
 There are eight games in the Premier League on Saturday and BBC Sport will bring you every moment. 
 Chelsea v Manchester United (12:30)
 Bournemouth v Leeds United
 Brentford v Nottingham Forest 
 Coventry City v Sunderland - first half on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 2 , second half on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 Hull City v Ipswich Town
 Manchester City v Brighton - listen on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Tottenham v Crystal Palace (17:30) - listen on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Aston Villa v Fulham (20:00)
 Kick-off times 15:00 GMT unless stated. 
 Follow all of the action and reaction here
 How to follow the Premier League weekend across the BBC 
 You can also listen to today's 5 Live Premier League commentaries on your smart speaker. Just say "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play Man City v Brighton" or "Alexa, ask BBC Sounds to play the Coventry match", for example. 
 New this season: Live match updates 
 Fans of Premier League clubs can now get real-time scores live on their phone lock screen for every game.
 Simply follow your favourite football teams on the BBC Sport app for updates throughout the 2026-27 season.
 Find out more here 
 Image source, BBC Sport New this season: Match of the Day Predictor 
 Simply predict the outcome of the six fixtures we've selected from across domestic and European competitions every week.
 Players can join at any time, get involved with the latest round and start building a streak.
 Read more about it here
